summary_en: Wel-Dish corrected disclosures regarding its simplified share exchange to acquire Grand Roof as a wholly-owned subsidiary, following an independent investigation committee's finding that company information previously disclosed—including shareholder composition, employee count, major clients, and financial performance—differed from actual facts.
title_en: Correction to Notice Regarding Complete Acquisition of Grand Roof Co., Ltd. through Simplified Share Exchange
translation_en_brief: On November 10, 2026, Wel-Dish announced corrections to its February 20, 2025 disclosure regarding the simplified share exchange to make Grand Roof Co., Ltd. a wholly-owned subsidiary. The corrections were prompted by findings from an independent investigation committee report issued on August 10, 2026, which revealed that certain company information disclosed under the direction of a then-managing director contained inaccuracies. Specifically, information regarding shareholder composition, employee headcount, major business partners, and operating results for Grand Roof did not match actual facts. The disclosure document identified corrections affecting section 5, "Overview of Parties to the Share Exchange," with corrections marked by underlines in the official notice. The independent investigation committee's review established that material information about the target company had been misstated in the original M&A announcement.
